Job Description

The Temporary Senior Manager, Accounting and Reporting, will provide critical short-term support to the University’s Office of the Controller during year-end close and financial statement preparation cycle. This position will assist in the compilation of the University’s consolidated financial statements, coordination of external audit requests, and completion of year-end reporting deliverables. The role ensures continuity of the accounting and reporting operations, and contributes to the accuracy, timeliness and compliance of financial reporting accordance with GAAP and University policies.

Supervisory Authority

This position does not supervise full-time employees but may guide or review accounting staff and managers during audit and reporting tasks.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include colleagues within the Office of the Controller, Financial Reporting, Sponsored Research, Budget Office, Treasury, and Financial Systems teams. External contacts include independent auditors, external consultants, and representatives of partner organizations or regulatory agencies requiring financial data or disclosure.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in the preparation and review of the annual consolidated financial statements and related footnote disclosures.
  • Review GAAP and Nonprofit Organization Disclosure Checklists.
  • Coordinate audit schedules, respond to external auditors’ requests, and ensure timely submission of supporting documentation.
  • Support preparation of year-end financial reports for internal and external stakeholders, including banking and regulatory institutions.
  • Support the Accounting and Reporting team with ad hoc analyses and reporting tasks as assigned.
  • Ensure that all footnote disclosures are comprehensive, correct, and consistent with supporting documentation.
Core Competencies
  • Technical Accounting Expertise, including accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (GAAP) for not-for-profit entities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to grammar and diction.
  • Financial analysis and Reporting Accuracy.
  • Audit Preparation and Coordination.
  • Attention to Detail and Analytical Rigor.
  • Collaboration and Communication.
  • Professional Integrity and Confidentiality.
Minimum Requirements

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

About The Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose‑led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income, and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

Responsibilities
  • Support members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement process, training and events.
  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team and support reporting for the region.
Membership Engagement & Support
  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and elevate when needed.
  • Support external communications and raise awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.
Supply Chain Operations
  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in‑person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.
Reporting & Administration
  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.
Essential
  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – advanced Excel functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for online and in‑person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, adaptability, problem‑solving, attention to detail, and time management.
Desirable
  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Power BI or similar tool.
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability.
  • Cultural sensitivity.
  • Initiative and ownership.

  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements.
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year.
  • Continuous learning and development.
  • Life insurance, dental insurance, medical insurance, meal voucher allowance.
  • 13th salary (bonus) – paid in 2 installments Nov/Dev.
  • Legal protections of local labour law and all other Better Cotton Global Policies apply.
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8–9 bank holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued.
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.
Working Arrangements

The position is full‑time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply Now

In your cover letter, please explain why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Interviews

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI`s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recuperar os danificados, registrar na ficha pessoal do colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;
  • Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

  3. Product Marketing & Go-to-Market (GTM)
    Traduzir produto em valor (packaging, naming, mensagens e diferenciação). Planejar lançamentos e campanhas integradas com metas de receita, pipeline e adoção.

  4. Geração de Demanda
    Construir o motor de inbound e paid media (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), com foco em geração de leads qualificados e conversão. Integrar automação, CRM (HubSpot) e nutrição de leads.

  5. Parcerias, Eventos & Buzz
    Ativar parcerias estratégicas, co-marketing e eventos proprietários. Orquestrar presença da marca em feiras e ações de visibilidade.

  6. Conteúdo & Mídias Sociais
    Planejar e dirigir o conteúdo institucional e executivo (LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram), com foco em alcance qualificado, engajamento e geração de oportunidades.

  7. Sales Enablement
    Fornecer suporte ao time comercial com materiais, decks, cases e playbooks que acelerem o fechamento e reforcem a proposta de valor.

  8. Employer Branding & Endomarketing
    Atuar junto ao RH em campanhas de cultura e atração de talentos, fortalecendo o posicionamento de marca empregadora e engajamento interno.

  9. Dados, Automação & Operação
    Gerir a operação de marketing e automação (HubSpot, GA4, Looker). Garantir governança de dados, mensuração de resultados e otimização contínua das campanhas.

title: General Manager
description:
Company Description

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands‑on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship‑building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long‑term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision‑making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world‑class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:
  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

    Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model.

    Build quality relationships with the management team.

    Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak‑up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect.

    Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input.

    Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision‑making processes.

    Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well‑being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards.

    Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations.

    Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty.

    Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets.

    Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel.

    Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market.

    Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan.

    Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning.

    Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities.

    Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement.

    Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures.

    As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy.

    Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members.

    Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process.

    Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem‑solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best.

    Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements.

    Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks.

    Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition.

    Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents.

    Champions a "speak‑up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated.

    Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win‑win solutions.

Additional Information
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)
  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high‑performing cultures.
  • Experience in managing owner relations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bottom‑line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team‑building.
  • Creative and innovative mindset.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.
  • Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.
  • Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.
  • Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

description:
O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea). Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.
  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos em simuladores, replicando cenários reais de controle de poço (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).
  • Aplicar avaliações e exames, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade e integridade definidos pelo IADC.
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.
  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço.
  • Conhecimento Técnico:
    • Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading)
    • Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento
    • Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP)
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver theoretical and practical Well Control classes in line with the official IADC WellSharp curriculum.
  • Conduct simulator-based training, replicating real well control scenarios (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).
  • Administer assessments and examinations, ensuring compliance with IADC quality and integrity requirements.
  • Prepare performance reports, attendance records, and student results within both the IADC system and internal controls.
  • Ensure continuous updating of training materials, simulators, and resources in alignment with the current program version.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, contributing to the maintenance of the training center’s accreditation.
  • Collaborate with the instructor team and technical support staff on the development and improvement of courses.
Qualifications
  • Certification: IADC WellSharp‑approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.
  • Technical Knowledge:
    • Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading)
    • Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing and cementing operations
    • International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP)
  • Languages: Advanced English (mandatory).

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Overview

Job Family Group: Legal Group
Job Description:
The Legal Counsel is a key member of the Brazil C&P Legal Team, supporting the Production and Operations business by providing day-to-day legal advice on upstream matters, especially in Brazil. Responsibilities include advising on bid round qualifications, pre- and post-tender negotiations, agreements, regulatory analysis, JV management, and drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial contracts. The role requires adapting to regulatory changes, ensuring consistency with BP US/UK legal standards, managing multiple complex projects, and representing the business in industry associations and government bodies. Candidates must hold a law degree from a top-tier Brazilian university with active OAB, possess upstream experience from specialized law firms or oil & gas companies, and demonstrate fluency in English, with expertise in oil & gas contracts, strategic legal risk management, and stakeholder influence in matrix organizations.

Key Results / Accountabilities
  • Responsible for providing day to day legal advice on legal matters involving Upstream businesses in the region, especially in Brazil.
  • Provide legal advice and support the business in bid round qualification, supporting pre- and post-tender negotiations, agreements and regulatory analysis.
  • Legal support to the business in Joint Venture management.
  • Drafting, reviewing and supporting the negotiation of commercial contracts such as services, distributor, product supply, logistics, sales and power agreements.
  • Represent the business supported in class association and government bodies when needed.
Key challenges faced on the role
  • Adapt to changes.
  • Follow up on recent changes in the regulation.
  • Ensure consistency between Brazil and BP US/UK legal requirements.
  • Prioritize resources and manage workload between the ongoing matters/projects.
  • Deal with multiple complex matters at same time.
  • Comfortable supporting within operational tasks as needed
Experience and Expertise
  • Law Degree from a top tier Brazilian university with active OAB.
  • 5+ years of proven senior experience
  • Upstream experience with expertise in managing profit-sharing agreements during both the development and production phases.
  • English (fluent)
  • Spanish (will be considered a PLUS)
  • Experience in top tier law firm or oil & gas company (operator and non-operator)
Country / Cluster

South America (except for Argentina)

Required Competencies
  • Strategic Legal Risk Management: Ability to anticipate, assess, and mitigate legal risks in complex, high-stakes environments, especially during rapid expansion phases and under cost constraints.
  • Business-Oriented Legal Advice: Skill in delivering pragmatic, commercially aligned legal guidance that supports operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.
  • Stakeholder Influence in Matrix Organizations: Strong communication and negotiation skills to navigate cross-functional teams, global reporting lines, and diverse cultural contexts.
  • Expertise in Oil & Gas Contracts and Regulatory Frameworks: Deep understanding of Brazilian upstream agreements (e.g., profit-sharing, joint ventures), local energy regulations, related areas such as environmental, compliance and labor.
  • Agility and Resilience Under Pressure: Capacity to manage high workloads, shifting priorities, and urgent matters with composure and adaptability.
  • Cost-Conscious Delivery Excellence: Demonstrated ability to drive legal outcomes that balance cost-efficiency with high-quality execution demonstrating smart resourcing, process optimization, and strategic prioritization to meet business needs without compromising standards.

  • This is a Hybrid 60/40 role subject company policy

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top‑tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This role involves leading development of a secure, user‑friendly Linux operating system built on Wayland, MicroVMs and immutability principles and be compatible across diverse devices—from desktops to smart watches. It emphasizes security comparable to Qubes OS through virtualization and compartmentalization, while prioritizing convenience and ease of use. As the lead developer, you will initiate and guide the project from its foundational stages.

Responsibilities
  • Lead and mentor a team of Linux developers, ensuring high code quality, adherence to open source practices, and kernel development standards.
  • Design and implement core OS components, including kernel modifications, user‑space tools, and system integrations for robustness, security, and performance.
  • Collaborate with hardware and security teams to ensure seamless integration and broad device compatibility.
  • Partner with a project manager to define technical roadmaps, prioritize tasks, and achieve project milestones, identifying risks and implementing solutions promptly.
  • Provide hands‑on leadership to bootstrap the project, including initial development, recruiting key personnel, and fostering open source community engagement.
  • Conduct code and architecture reviews to optimize for stability, performance, and hardware compatibility.
  • Stay informed on advancements in the Linux ecosystem, kernel developments, and relevant tools, incorporating innovations as appropriate.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership in Linux distributions, kernel contributions, or related open source projects (e.g., GNOME, systemd).
  • At least 6 years of hands‑on experience in Linux OS development, including kernel programming, distribution packaging, and low‑level system development in C/C++.
  • Proven track record in building open source communities and managing partnerships.
  • Essential experience with immutability (e.g., atomic updates), containerization (e.g., Docker, Podman), virtualization (e.g., QEMU, KVM, Xen for security isolation), Wayland compositing, and cross‑device portability.
  • Strong understanding of operating system principles, security models (e.g., SELinux, AppArmor), and hardware‑software interfaces.
  • Excellent leadership, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
Highly desirable experience
  • Prior experience leading Linux engineering teams and collaborating with open source communities, as well as knowledge of distributed systems or embedded Linux.
Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

description:
Overview

Project Kuiper is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Kuiper is seeking an experienced, self-motivated Sales Professional to lead the adoption of Amazon Kuiper broadband and related services with maritime and offshore partners and end users in Brazil. This role is a unique opportunity to build and execute our sales pipeline with major offshore operators, service contractors, and merchant marine customers. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in selling to, managing, and supporting large Energy sector clients, with maritime experience preferred. Knowledge of agriculture, OEM, and aviation industries is a plus. A solid understanding of satellite communications, experience working with global remote teams, and the ability to manage complex, long-term deals from start to finish are essential. You will be responsible for growing maritime and mobility opportunities in Brazil, managing both direct and channel engagements. This includes working with local partners to establish infrastructure that supports high-value contracts and leading cross-functional teams to deliver on customer and partner initiatives. Strong relationship skills and fluency in English and Portuguese are required.

Please note: This role may involve access to information or technology subject to U.S. export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). Employment is contingent on obtaining any necessary licenses or approvals from the U.S. government, based on eligibility under these regulations.

Key job responsibilities
  • Contribute to the build out of Amazon Kuiper service revenue with specific focus on Mobility partners and end users.
  • Be customer obsessed. Think on behalf of the customer and work to meet the customer’s stated and unstated needs and aspirations
  • Execute strategic and tactical business development initiatives while working with key internal stakeholders (e.g., Amazon Kuiper product and engineering teams, legal, finance) and BD team colleagues.
  • Be the internal coordinator supporting complex contract negotiations and complex business requirements and activities which deliver results.
  • Adept at thinking strategically and analytically about business priorities, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to deliver target based results working cross-organizationally.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including a passion for writing detailed strategic documents and a preference for a second fluent spoken language.
  • Consistently exceeds key performance metrics and delivers results.
  • Experience driving consensus across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be able to articulate business value & technical approach.
A day in the life

Kuiper's Sales strategy and Go To Market plan is well defined and yet each working day is different from the next. The satellite Mobility sector is global and our customer engagements take us around the world whether on video calls on supporting face to face engagements. We may start the day with a customer call with Australia and finish the day with a channel partner meeting in Austin. Taking time during a busy day to evaluate critical data points and develop strategies and tactics is important. As is the process of codifying these decisions and their outcomes.

About the team

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust. Experience with Oil and Gas customers. Fluent in Portuguese. Bsc or Msc in telecommunications. MBA. Understanding of regulatory landscape and import tax in Brazil.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location : we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills we would value

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Prepare-se para o Verão! Integre a Operação Rio Academia 2025!

A Mude está se preparando para a próxima edição do projeto mais aguardado do Rio de Janeiro: a Rio Academia!

Montaremos mais uma vez, a nossa academia ao ar livre na Praia de Ipanema, oferecendo aulas de musculação e diversas atividades coletivas como dança, yoga, treinos na areia e HIIT, de forma gratuita para a população durante o verão carioca.

Para manter o nível de excelência das edições anteriores, a nossa operação de banheira de gelo estará de volta, garantindo uma experiência incrível que promove recuperação de alta performance dos nossos alunos.

Fica ligado na descrição da atividade do profissional que estamos em busca para saber se você é o candidato ideal ;)

A Missão na Operação:

Você será o guardião da experiência de alta performance de nossos alunos, com as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Recepção e Gestão: Receber os alunos que realizaram agendamento e gerenciar o tempo de imersão de cada um.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Medir a temperatura da água da banheira de forma contínua.
  • Logística de Manutenção: Realizar proativamente as ações necessárias para a reposição de gelo e água durante toda a operação, garantindo o padrão de qualidade e segurança.
Requisitos Essenciais:

Devido à natureza especializada e aos cuidados com a saúde envolvidos na crioterapia de imersão, o candidato ideal deve possuir:

  • Formação Superior ou Técnica completa em áreas da saúde, tais como: Educação Física, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem ou áreas correlatas.
  • Capacidade Comprovada de administração e gestão de situações de primeiros socorros, incluindo o conhecimento sobre hipotermia ou qualquer mal-estar relacionado à imersão em água fria será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proatividade, excelente comunicação e organização.
  • Disponibilidade para o turno da tarde/noite.

Se você se encaixa nos requisitos e tem paixão por levar a saúde e a inovação para o próximo nível, queremos te conhecer!

Vem com a Mude transformar cidades em espaços de bem-estar!

A Mude é mais que uma empresa, somos um movimento de wellness media com o coração no Rio e os pés em mais de 7 cidades do Brasil! Levamos bem-estar para as ruas com aulas e academias ao ar livre iradas, além de estações de treino e alongamento que você encontra dando um rolê pela cidade. E a melhor parte? É tudo DE GRAÇA! Nosso propósito é simples: fazer das cidades um lugar mais saudável e feliz para todo mundo.

Na Mude, a gente cria experiências que transformam o dia a dia das pessoas, e o nosso app é o portal mágico para tudo isso! Por ele você se inscreve nas aulas, assiste lives que botam pra cima, acha as estações de treino mais perto e muito mais. Já tá com o nosso app no celular? Se não, corre lá! ??

E como a gente faz tudo isso ser free? Com a galera que acredita no nosso propósito! Empresas e marcas que também querem ver a qualidade de vida das pessoas lá no alto investem na Mude e, em troca, a gente entrega mídia super bacana no app e nos painéis espalhados pela cidade.

description:
Overview

(Rio de Janeiro) Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)

Descrição da vaga: Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros! Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
  • Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
Você se diferenciará
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais
  • PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO: São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira. E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

title: Financial Applications Director
description:
Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities
  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Overview

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor)
  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.
What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
Physical Requirements
  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.
Reporting Relationships

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.
